confidence_notes: Local and Vietnam-wide price data give a useful basis for meals, coffee, beer and dorm beds, but city-specific data are incomplete and hostel prices vary by season. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price relationship to draft beer. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Ninh Binh and Tam Coc local travel-cost guidance, supplemented by Vietnam-wide restaurant price averages for anchors with limited city-level data.
